title: Knowledge graph (Links or Graphify source)
description: What the 2D and 3D Knowledge Graphs draw. kg-links writes the Links graph from Markdown notes; kg-graphify writes the Graphify graph from Graphify's graph.json.

id.description: Unique. For notes, the path relative to the notes folder.

linkCount.description: Links touching the node; the node limit keeps the most connected.

path.description: Note path used by path: searches and colour groups. Defaults to id.

note.description: Graphify: the note the node was extracted from; opened on click.

type.description: Graphify: document, concept, rationale or paper.

inferred.description: Graphify reasoned this link rather than reading it; drawn with a warm tint.
